items.q: The engineer ______ handles this case is on leave.
Please tell me ______ you need.（你需要的東西）
This is the only supplier ______ can do 28 AWG.
The factory ______ we make the cable is in Vietnam.
items.note: 地點、後面句子完整 → where。

items.q: The supplier missed the date again, ______ is unacceptable.
items.note: 逗點 + which 指前面整件事。

items.q: The customer ______ order was delayed has asked for a discount.

choices: the issue that we discussed last week
the issue that we discussed it last week
the issue what we discussed last week
the issue which we discussed it
items.note: that 已經是受詞，後面不放 it。

choices: the supplier with that we work
items.note: 介係詞留句尾，that 省略。

items.q: The samples, ______ failed, were from batch 3.（全部都失敗）
Send me ______ you have.（任何你有的）
你昨天寄的那張圖面有一個錯。
items.a: The drawing (that) you sent yesterday has an error.

items.q: 負責這個案子的工程師下週會聯絡你。
items.a: The engineer who handles this case will contact you next week.

items.q: 他們核准了圖面，這表示我們可以開始了。
items.a: They approved the drawing, which means we can start.

items.q: 測試失敗的原因是材料不對。
items.a: The reason (why) the test failed is the wrong material.
